questions.question: Evaluate: 5 × 4 + (3 + 4)² ÷ 7 × 4

questions.question: Selling price of an article is Rs. 616. If loss percentage is 30 percent. then what Is the cost price of article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (S.P) = Rs.616

Loss % = 30%

**Formula used:**

S.P = Cost price (C.P) × (100 - L)%

**Calculation:**

S.P = C.P × (100 - L)%

⇒ 616 = C.P × (100 - 30)%

⇒ 616 = C.P × 70 %

⇒ C.P = (616 × 100)/70

⇒ C.P = Rs.880

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.880.**

questions.question: The average of 5 consecutive natural numbers is 43. The largest of these numbers is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 5 consecutive natural numbers = 43

**Concept used:**

Average of 'n' consecutive number = sum of 'n' number/'n'

**Calculation:**

Sum of consecutive natural numbers = 43 × 5 = 215

⇒ x + (x + 1) + (x + 2) + (x + 3) + (x + 4) = 215

⇒ 5x + 10 = 215

⇒ 5x = 205

⇒ x = 41

The largest number = 41 + 4 = 45

**∴ The correct answer is 45.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__****Calculation:**

Average of 5 consecutive natural numbers = 43. 

So, The middle term of consecutive series = 43 

The series = 41, 42, 43, 44, 45

Largest number = 45

∴ The correct answer is 45.

questions.question: X boys can do a work in 80 days. In how much time, 2X boys will do half of the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X boys can do a work in 80 days

**Concept used:**

(M₁ × H₁ × D₁)/ W₁ = (M2 × H2 × D2)/ W2

**Calculation:**

⇒ (M1 × D1)/ W1 = (M2 × D2)/ W2

⇒ (X × 80)/1 = (2X × D2)/0.5

⇒ D2 = 20 days

**∴ The correct answer is 20 days.**

questions.question: A bus travels first 100 km at a speed of 100 km/hr. It covers next 150 km at a speed of 90 km/hr. What is the average speed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The speed of bus for first 100 km = 100 km/hr

The speed of bus for next 150 km = 90 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average speed = total distance/total time taken

**Calculation:**

Total distance = 100 + 150 = 250 km

Time taken for first 100 km = 100/100 = 1 hour

Time taken for first 100 km = 150/90 = 5/3 hour

Average speed = total distance/total time taken

⇒ 250/{1 + (5/3)}

⇒ (250 × 3)/8 = 93.75 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 93.75 km/hr.**

questions.question: What is the area of the lateral surface of a right circular cylinder, If the circumference of the base is 22 cm and its height is four times of its radius?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Circumference of the base of cylinder = 22 cm

Height (h) = 4 × radius(r)

**Concept used:**

Circumference of circle = 2 × π × r

The lateral surface area of cylinder = 2 × π × r × h

**Calculation:**

Circumference of circle = 2 × π × r

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r = 22

⇒ r = 3.5 cm

Height (h) = 4 × radius(r)

⇒ h = 4 × 3.5 = 14 cm

The lateral surface area of cylinder = 2 × π × r × h

⇒ 22 × 14 = 308 cm2

**∴ The correct answer is 308 cm2.**

questions.question: The greatest number which when divides 456 and 553 leaves the remainder as 6 and 3 respectively is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First number = 456 ; second number = 553

**Calculation:**

⇒ 456 - 6 = 450

⇒ 553 - 3 = 550

Now,

⇒ 450 = 5 × 3 × 3 × 2 × 5

⇒ 550 = 5 × 11 × 2 × 5

HCF of 450 and 550 = 5 × 5 × 2 = 50

**∴ The correct answer is 50.**

questions.question: Find compound interest on Rs. 60000 at 10% per annum for 5 years, compounded annually.
questions.solution:

Principal = Rs.60000 ; Rate% = 10% ; Time = 5 years

**Formula used:**

A = P × (100 + R%)T

Compound interest (C.I) = (A - P)

Where, A = amount ; P = principal ; T = time ; R = rate

**Calculation:**

Amount = P × (100 + R%)T

⇒ 60000 × (110/100)⁵

⇒ 60000 × (11/10)5

⇒ 60000 × (161051/100000)

⇒ 6 × 16105.1 = 96630.6

Compound interest (C.I) = (A - P)

⇒ 96630.6 - 60000 = 36630.60

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.36630.60.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper sells a box and earn a profit of 5%. For the next box he decides to charge double the selling price. What is the profit percent on second box?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling the first box earns a profit = 5%

**Formula used:**

Selling price = Cost price + profit

Profit % = (S.P ~- ~C.P)over C.P × 100

**Calculation:**

Selling the first box earns a profit = 5%

CP : SP = 100 : 105

According to the question:

He changes the selling price to double

So, new S.P = 105 × 2 = 210

Profit % = (S.P - C.P)over C.P × 100

⇒ {(210 - 100)/100} × 100

⇒ {110/100} × 100 

⇒ 110%

**∴ The correct answer is 110%.**

questions.question: A boy can row upstream at 12 km/hr and downstream at 23 km/hr. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Upstream speed = 12 km/hr

Downstream speed = 23 km/hr

**Concept used:**

Upstream speed = speed of boat - speed of stream

Downstream speed = speed of boat + speed of stream

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of boat = U

Speed of stream = V

Upstream speed = U + V = 23 km/hr

Downstream speed = U - V = 12 km/hr

The speed of stream (V) = (23 -12)/2

⇒ 11/2 = 5.5 km/hr

**∴ The speed of stream = 5.5 km/hr.**
